title.zh: 卷二十四 本紀第二十四: 道宗四
title.raw: 卷二十四 本紀第二十四: 道宗四 Volume 24 Annals 24: Daozong 4

sentences.zh: 道宗四

translations.literal: Daozong, Part Four
translations.idiomatic: Daozong, Part Four

sentences.zh: 五年春正月壬申，如混同江。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on renshen day, went to the Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on renshen day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，賜宰相耶律孝傑名仁傑。

translations.literal: On guiyou day granted chancellor Yelü Xiaojie the name Renjie.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day chancellor Yelü Xiaojie was granted the name Renjie.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，如山榆澱。

translations.literal: On yihai day went to Shanyu Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the court went to Shanyu Marsh.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，以宰相仁傑獲頭鵝，加侍中。

translations.literal: Third month, on xinwei day, because Chancellor Renjie obtained a swan's head, he was promoted Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day of the third month, because Chancellor Renjie obtained a swan's head, he was promoted Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以北院樞密使魏王耶律乙辛知南院大王事，加於越，知北院樞密使事耶律霂為北院樞密使，北院樞密副使耶律特裏底知北院樞密使事，左夷離畢耶律世遷同知北院樞密使事。

translations.literal: On renchen day Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was made to administer Southern Court great king affairs and promoted yuyue; Yelü Li, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Yelü Telidi administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Shiqian associate Northern Court privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was made to administer Southern Court great king affairs and promoted yuyue; Yelü Li, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Yelü Telidi was made administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Shiqian was made associate Northern Court privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未，如納葛濼。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiwei day, went to Nage Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day of the fourth summer month the court went to Nage Marsh.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥，謁慶陵。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on dinghai day, paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day of the fifth month the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 以契丹行宮都部署耶律燕哥為南府宰相，北面林牙耶律永寧為夷離畢，同知南院樞密使事蕭撻不也及殿前副點檢、駙馬都尉蕭酬斡並封蘭陵郡王。

translations.literal: Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Yange Southern Court chancellor; Northern linya Yelü Yongning yilibi; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Tabuye and Palace Front deputy commander and imperial son-in-law Xiao Chouwo were all enfeoffed Prince of Lanling Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Yange was made Southern Court chancellor; Northern linya Yelü Yongning was made yilibi; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Tabuye and Palace Front deputy commander and imperial son-in-law Xiao Chouwo were all enfeoffed Prince of Lanling Commandery.

sentences.zh: 六月辛亥，阻卜來貢。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on xinhai day, Zubu came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day of the sixth month Zubu came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以北府宰相、遼西郡王蕭餘里也為西北路招討使。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Northern Court chancellor and Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Northern Court chancellor and Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己未，遣使隸囚。

translations.literal: On jiwei day dispatched envoys to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day envoys were dispatched to review prisoners.

sentences.zh: 是月，放進士劉瓘等百一十三人。

translations.literal: That month the jinshi Liu Jin and one hundred thirteen others were passed.
translations.idiomatic: That month the jinshi Liu Jin and one hundred thirteen others were passed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，獵夾山。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jimao day, hunted at Jia Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Jia Mountain.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，命有司撰《太宗神功碑》，立於南京。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on gengshen day, ordered the relevant offices to compose the 《Stele of Taizong's Divine Merit》 and erect it at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day of the eighth month the relevant offices were ordered to compose the 《Stele of Taizong's Divine Merit》 and erect it at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，詔諸路毋禁僧徒開壇。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jimao day, edict ordered all routes not to forbid monks from opening altars.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day of the ninth month an edict ordered all routes not to forbid monks from opening altars.

sentences.zh: 壬午，禁扈從擾民。

translations.literal: On renwu day forbidden escorts to harass the people.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day escorts were forbidden to harass the people.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌，夏國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuxu day Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day of the tenth winter month Xia State sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己亥，駐蹕獨盧金。

translations.literal: On jihai day halted at Dulujin.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the court halted at Dulujin.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔惟皇子仍一字王，餘並削降。

translations.literal: On renzi day, edict ordered that only imperial sons might remain single-character princes; the rest were all demoted.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict ordered that only imperial sons might remain single-character princes; the rest were all demoted.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，振平州貧民。

translations.literal: On dingsi day relieved poor people in Ping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day poor people in Ping Prefecture were relieved.

sentences.zh: 己未，以趙王楊績為遼西郡王，魏王耶律乙辛降封混同郡王，吳王蕭韓家奴蘭陵郡王，致仕。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Prince of Zhao Yang Ji was made Prince of Liaoxi; Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was demoted to Prince of Huntong Commandery; Prince of Wu Xiao Hanjianu Prince of Lanling Commandery, retired.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Prince of Zhao Yang Ji was made Prince of Liaoxi; Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was demoted to Prince of Huntong Commandery; Prince of Wu Xiao Hanjianu Prince of Lanling Commandery, retired.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，召沙門守道開壇於內殿。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on dingchou day summoned monk Shoudao to open an altar in the inner hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day of the eleventh month monk Shoudao was summoned to open an altar in the inner hall.

sentences.zh: 癸未，復南京流民差役三年，被火之家免租稅一年。

translations.literal: On guimao day Nanjing refugees' corvée was remitted for three years; households that had suffered fire were exempt from rent and tax for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Nanjing refugees' corvée was remitted for three years; households that had suffered fire were exempt from rent and tax for one year.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，彗星犯尾。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on bingwu day a comet violated the Tail constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day of the twelfth month a comet violated the Tail constellation.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，幸西京。

translations.literal: On yimao day visited the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the court visited the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 戊午，行再生禮，赦雜犯死罪以下。

translations.literal: On wuwu day performed the rebirth ritual; amnesty for mixed offenses from capital crime downward.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the rebirth ritual was performed; amnesty was granted for mixed offenses from capital crime downward.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月癸酉，如鴛鴦濼。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on guiyou day, went to Yuanyang Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on guiyou day of the first spring month the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，耶律乙辛出知興中府事。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Yelü Yixin was dismissed as administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Yelü Yixin was dismissed as administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，封皇孫延禧為梁王，忠順軍節度使耶律頗德南院大王，耶律仲禧南院樞密使，戶部使陳毅參知政事。

translations.literal: Third month, on gengyin day enfeoffed imperial grandson Yanxi Prince of Liang; Zhongshun Army military commissioner Yelü Pode Southern Court great king; Yelü Zhongxi Southern Court privy commissioner; Household Commissioner Chen Yi Associate Administrator of Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day of the third month imperial grandson Yanxi was enfeoffed Prince of Liang; Zhongshun Army military commissioner Yelü Pode was made Southern Court great king; Yelü Zhongxi Southern Court privy commissioner; Household Commissioner Chen Yi Associate Administrator of Affairs.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，獵炭山。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on yimao day, hunted at Tanshan.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day of the fourth summer month the court hunted at Tanshan.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申，免平州復業民租賦一年。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on renshen day, remitted one year's rent and tax for Ping Prefecture households resuming cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day of the fifth month one year's rent and tax for Ping Prefecture households resuming cultivation was remitted.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以旱，禱雨，命左右以水相沃，俄而雨降。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, because of drought, prayed for rain; ordered attendants to douse one another with water, and soon rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, because of drought, rain was prayed for; attendants were ordered to douse one another with water, and soon rain fell.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌，駐蹕納葛濼。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on wuxu day, halted at Nage Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day of the sixth month the court halted at Nage Marsh.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以度支使王績參知政事。

translations.literal: On wushen day Revenue Commissioner Wang Ji Associate Administrator of Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Revenue Commissioner Wang Ji was made Associate Administrator of Affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，女直遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On gengxu day Jurchen dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，觀市。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuchen day viewed the market.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day of the seventh autumn month the court viewed the market.

sentences.zh: 癸未，為皇孫梁王延禧設旗鼓拽剌六人衛護之。

translations.literal: On guimao day six drum-and-banner zhala guards were established to protect imperial grandson Prince of Liang Yanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day six drum-and-banner zhala guards were established to protect imperial grandson Prince of Liang Yanxi.

sentences.zh: 甲申，獵沙嶺。

translations.literal: On jiashen day hunted at Shaling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the court hunted at Shaling.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，祠木葉山。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on renyin day sacrificed at Muye Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day of the ninth month sacrifice was made at Muye Mountain.

sentences.zh: 己酉，駐蹕藕絲澱。

translations.literal: On jiyou day halted at Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未朔，省同知廣德軍節度使事，命奉先軍節度使兼巡警乾、顯二州。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiwei new moon, abolished the post of associate Guangde Army military commissioner; ordered Fengxian Army military commissioner also to patrol Qian and Xian prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei new moon of the tenth winter month the post of associate Guangde Army military commissioner was abolished; Fengxian Army military commissioner was ordered also to patrol Qian and Xian prefectures.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，耶律仁傑出為武定軍節度使。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Yelü Renjie was dismissed as military commissioner of Wuding Army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Yelü Renjie was dismissed as military commissioner of Wuding Army.

sentences.zh: 庚午，參知政事劉詵致仕。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Associate Administrator of Affairs Liu Shen retired.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Associate Administrator of Affairs Liu Shen retired.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以陳毅為漢人行宮都部署，王績同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Chen Yi was made Han mobile palace deployment director; Wang Ji associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Chen Yi was made Han mobile palace deployment director; Wang Ji associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，回鶻遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Uighur dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Uighur sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月己丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jichou new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou new moon of the eleventh month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，召群臣議政。

translations.literal: On guimao day summoned ministers to discuss government.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day ministers were summoned to discuss government.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，以耶律特裏底為孟父敞穩。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiazi day Yelü Telidi was made Mengfu detail-stable.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day of the twelfth month Yelü Telidi was made Mengfu detail-stable.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以蕭撻不也為北府宰相，耶律世遷知北院樞密使事，耶律慎思同知北院樞密使事。

translations.literal: On yichou day Xiao Tabuye was made Northern Court chancellor; Yelü Shiqian administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Yelü Shensi associate Northern Court privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Xiao Tabuye was made Northern Court chancellor; Yelü Shiqian was made administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Yelü Shensi associate Northern Court privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚午，免西京流民租賦一年。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Western Capital refugees' rent and tax were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Western Capital refugees' rent and tax were remitted for one year.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，減民賦。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day the people's tax levies were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the people's tax levies were reduced.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，豫行正旦禮。

translations.literal: On dinghai day New Year's rites were performed in advance.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day New Year's rites were performed in advance.

sentences.zh: 戊子，如混同江。

translations.literal: On wuzi day went to the Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the court went to the Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月戊申，五國部長來貢。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on wushen day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on wushen day of the first spring month chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，女直貢良馬。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Jurchen presented fine horses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Jurchen presented fine horses.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，如魚兒濼。

translations.literal: Second month, on jiazi day, went to Yuer Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day of the second month the court went to Yuer Marsh.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬子，駐蹕嶺西。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, on renzi day, halted west of the ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day of the fifth summer month the court halted west of the ridge.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，有司奏永清、武清、固安三縣蝗。

translations.literal: On guichou day the relevant offices memorialized locusts in Yongqing, Wuqing, and Gu'an counties.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the relevant offices memorialized locusts in Yongqing, Wuqing, and Gu'an counties.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以蕭撻不也兼殿前都點檢，蕭酬斡為漢人行宮都部署兼知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Xiao Tabuye was also Palace Front commander; Xiao Chouwo Han mobile palace deployment director and associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Xiao Tabuye was also Palace Front commander; Xiao Chouwo was made Han mobile palace deployment director and associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子，詔月祭觀德殿，歲寒食，諸帝在時生辰及忌日，詣景宗御容殿致奠。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jiazi day, edict ordered monthly sacrifice at Guande Hall; on Cold Food each year, on birthdays and death days while emperors lived, proceed to Jingzong's imperial portrait hall to offer sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day of the sixth month an edict ordered monthly sacrifice at Guande Hall; on Cold Food each year, on birthdays and death days while emperors lived, proceed to Jingzong's imperial portrait hall to offer sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，阻卜余古赧來貢。

translations.literal: On bingyin day Zubu Yugunian came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Zubu Yugunian came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以翰林學士王言敷參知政事，封北院宣徽使石篤漆水郡王。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Hanlin academician Wang Yanfu Associate Administrator of Affairs; Northern Court palace commissioner Shi Du enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Hanlin academician Wang Yanfu was made Associate Administrator of Affairs; Northern Court palace commissioner Shi Du was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，如秋山。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuzi day, went to autumn mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day of the seventh autumn month the court went to autumn mountains.

sentences.zh: 丙申，謁慶陵。

translations.literal: On bingshen day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，射鹿赤山，加圍場使涅葛為靜江軍節度使。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on dingmao day shot deer at Red Mountain; hunting-grounds commissioner Niege was promoted military commissioner of Jingjiang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day of the eighth month deer were shot at Red Mountain; hunting-grounds commissioner Niege was promoted military commissioner of Jingjiang Army.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，次懷州，命皇謁懷陵。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on wuzi day halted at Huai Prefecture; ordered the crown prince to pay respects at Huai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day of the ninth month the court halted at Huai Prefecture; the crown prince was ordered to pay respects at Huai Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，次祖州，命皇后謁祖陵。

translations.literal: On xinmao day halted at Zu Prefecture; ordered the Empress to pay respects at the ancestral mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the court halted at Zu Prefecture; the Empress was ordered to pay respects at the ancestral mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，駐蹕藕絲澱。

translations.literal: On yisi day halted at Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，以惕隱王九為南院大王，夷離畢奚抄只為彰國軍節度使。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuchen day tiyin Wangjiu was made Southern Court great king; yilibi Xi Chaozhi military commissioner of Zhangguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day of the tenth winter month tiyin Wangjiu was made Southern Court great king; yilibi Xi Chaozhi military commissioner of Zhangguo Army.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，詔歲出官錢，振諸宮分及邊戍貧戶。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yiyou day, edict ordered yearly disbursement of official funds to relieve poor households of various palace divisions and border garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day of the eleventh month an edict ordered yearly disbursement of official funds to relieve poor households of various palace divisions and border garrisons.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，幸駙馬都尉蕭酬斡第，方飲，宰相梁穎諫曰：「天子不可飲人臣家。

translations.literal: On dinghai day visited imperial son-in-law Xiao Chouwo's residence; while drinking, Chancellor Liang Ying admonished: "The Son of Heaven must not drink in a subject's house.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the court visited imperial son-in-law Xiao Chouwo's residence; while drinking, Chancellor Liang Ying admonished: "The Son of Heaven must not drink in a subject's house.

sentences.zh: 」上即還宮。

translations.literal: " The Emperor immediately returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor immediately returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 己亥，高麗遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On jihai day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，除絹帛尺度狹短之令。

translations.literal: On xinhai day abolished the regulation on narrow silk and cloth measures.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the regulation on narrow silk and cloth measures was abolished.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，武定軍節度使耶律仁傑以罪削爵為民。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on dingmao day Wuding Army military commissioner Yelü Renjie, for an offense, was stripped of rank and made a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day of the twelfth month Wuding Army military commissioner Yelü Renjie, for an offense, was stripped of rank and made a commoner.

sentences.zh: 辛未，知興中府事耶律乙辛以罪囚於來州。

translations.literal: On xinwei day Xingzhong Prefecture administrator Yelü Yixin, for an offense, was imprisoned at Laizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Xingzhong Prefecture administrator Yelü Yixin, for an offense, was imprisoned at Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月甲申，如混同江。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, spring, first month, on jiashen day, went to the Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, on jiashen day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，鐵驪、五國諸長各貢方物。

translations.literal: On dingyou day chiefs of Tieli and the Five States each presented local products.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day chiefs of Tieli and the Five States each presented local products.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，如山榆澱。

translations.literal: Second month, on wuwu day, went to Shanyu Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day of the second month the court went to Shanyu Marsh.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔北、南院官，凡給驛者，必先奏聞。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, edict ordered Northern and Southern Court officials: whoever used post stations must first memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict ordered Northern and Southern Court officials: whoever used post stations must first memorialize.

sentences.zh: 貢新及奏獄訟，方許馳驛，餘並禁之。

translations.literal: Only when presenting tribute of new products or memorializing criminal cases might they ride post relays; the rest were all forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Only when presenting tribute of new products or memorializing criminal cases might they ride post relays; the rest were all forbidden.

sentences.zh: 己巳，夏國獲宋將張天一，遣使來獻。

translations.literal: On jisi day Xia State captured Song general Zhang Tianyi and dispatched envoys to present him.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Xia State captured Song general Zhang Tianyi and sent envoys to present him.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以耶律頗德為南府宰相兼知北院樞密使，燕哥為惕隱，蕭撻不也兼知契丹行宮都部署事。

translations.literal: On renshen day Yelü Pode was made Southern Court chancellor and also administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Yange tiyin; Xiao Tabuye also administrator of Khitan mobile palace deployment affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Yelü Pode was made Southern Court chancellor and also administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Yange tiyin; Xiao Tabuye also administrator of Khitan mobile palace deployment affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌，黃龍府女直部長術乃率部民內附，予官，賜印綬。

translations.literal: Third month, on gengxu day Huanglong Prefecture Jurchen tribal chief Sunai led his tribesmen to submit; office was granted and seals bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day of the third month Huanglong Prefecture Jurchen tribal chief Sunai led his tribesmen to submit; office was granted and seals were bestowed.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔行黍所定升斗。

translations.literal: That month, edict ordered use of the bushel and peck Taixing had fixed.
translations.idiomatic: That month an edict ordered use of the bushel and peck Taixing had fixed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬戌，以耶律世遷為上京留守。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renxu day Yelü Shiqian was made supreme capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day of the fourth summer month Yelü Shiqian was made supreme capital regent.

sentences.zh: 六月辛亥朔，駐蹕納葛濼。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on xinhai new moon, halted at Nage Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai new moon of the sixth month the court halted at Nage Marsh.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，夏國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Xia State sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以耶律頗德為北院樞密使，耶律巢哥南府宰相，劉筠南院樞密使，蕭撻不也兼知北院樞密使事，王績漢人行宮都部署，蕭酬斡國舅詳穩。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Yelü Pode was made Northern Court privy commissioner; Yelü Chaoge Southern Court chancellor; Liu Yun Southern Court privy commissioner; Xiao Tabuye also administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Wang Ji Han mobile palace deployment director; Xiao Chouwo imperial maternal uncle detail-stable.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Yelü Pode was made Northern Court privy commissioner; Yelü Chaoge Southern Court chancellor; Liu Yun Southern Court privy commissioner; Xiao Tabuye also administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Wang Ji Han mobile palace deployment director; Xiao Chouwo imperial maternal uncle detail-stable.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，阻卜長來貢。

translations.literal: On yichou day Zubu chiefs came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Zubu chiefs came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以耶律慎思知右夷離畢事。

translations.literal: On bingzi day Yelü Shensi was made administrator of Right yilibi affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Yelü Shensi was made administrator of Right yilibi affairs.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲午，如秋山。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiawu day, went to autumn mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day of the seventh autumn month the court went to autumn mountains.

sentences.zh: 南京霖雨，沙河溢永清、歸義、新城、安次、武清、香河六縣，傷稼。

translations.literal: Nanjing had continuous rain; the Sha River overflowed Yongqing, Guiyi, Xincheng, Anci, Wuqing, and Xianghe six counties and injured the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing had continuous rain; the Sha River overflowed Yongqing, Guiyi, Xincheng, Anci, Wuqing, and Xianghe six counties and injured the crops.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，謁慶陵。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on gengyin day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day of the ninth month the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 丁未，駐蹕藕絲澱。

translations.literal: On dingwei day halted at Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 大風雪，牛馬多死，賜扈從官以下衣馬有差。

translations.literal: Great wind and snow; many cattle and horses died; clothing and horses were bestowed on escort officials and below by degree.
translations.idiomatic: Great wind and snow fell; many cattle and horses died; clothing and horses were bestowed on escort officials and below by degree.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯，詔化哥傅導梁王延禧，加金吾衛大將軍。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on yimao day, edict ordered Huage to tutor Prince of Liang Yanxi; promoted Defender of the Golden Crow Commandant grand general.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day of the tenth winter month an edict ordered Huage to tutor Prince of Liang Yanxi; Defender of the Golden Crow Commandant was promoted grand general.

sentences.zh: 丙子，謁乾陵。

translations.literal: On bingzi day paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the court paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，以乙室大王蕭何葛為南院宣徽使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on renwu day Yishi great king Xiao Hege was made Southern Court palace commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day of the eleventh month Yishi great king Xiao Hege was made Southern Court palace commissioner.

sentences.zh: 權知奚六部大王事圖趕為本部大王。

translations.literal: Acting administrator of Xi Six Tribes great king affairs Tugan was made great king of that tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Acting administrator of Xi Six Tribes great king affairs Tugan was made great king of that tribe.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑，烏古敵烈統軍使耶律馬五為北院大王。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on guichou day Wugu Dilie supreme commander Yelü Mawu was made Northern Court great king.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day of the twelfth month Wugu Dilie supreme commander Yelü Mawu was made Northern Court great king.

sentences.zh: 庚申，降皇后為惠妃，出居乾陵。

translations.literal: On gengshen day the Empress was demoted to Consort Hui and sent to dwell at Qian Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Empress was demoted to Consort Hui and sent to dwell at Qian Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月辛巳，如春水。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, spring, first month, on xinsi day, went to spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, on xinsi day of the first spring month the court went to spring waters.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙午朔，大雪，平地丈餘，馬死者十六七。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingwu new moon, heavy snow fell more than a zhang deep on level ground; sixty or seventy percent of horses died.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu new moon of the fourth summer month heavy snow fell more than a zhang deep on level ground; sixty or seventy percent of horses died.

sentences.zh: 五月，如黑嶺。

translations.literal: Fifth month went to Heiling.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the court went to Heiling.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，駐蹕散水原。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jiwei day, halted at Sanshui Plain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day of the sixth month the court halted at Sanshui Plain.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以耶律阿思為契丹行宮都部署，耶律慎思北院樞密副使。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Yelü Asi was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director; Yelü Shensi Northern Court associate privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Yelü Asi was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director; Yelü Shensi Northern Court associate privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔諸路檢括脫戶，罪至死者，原之。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, edict ordered all routes to register escaped households; offenses reaching death were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day an edict ordered all routes to register escaped households; offenses reaching death were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁丑，以漢人行宮副部署可汗奴為南院大王。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on dingchou day Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Kehannu was made Southern Court great king.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on dingchou day, Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Kehannu was made Southern Court great king.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，追謚庶人浚為昭懷太子。

translations.literal: On wuyin day posthumously honored the commoner Jun as Crown Prince Zhaohuai.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the commoner Jun was posthumously honored as Crown Prince Zhaohuai.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，阻卜來貢。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Zubu came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Zubu came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以知興中府事邢熙年為漢人行宮都部署，漢人行宮都部署王績為南院樞密副使。

translations.literal: On jichou day Xingzhong Prefecture administrator Xing Xinian was made Han mobile palace deployment director; Han mobile palace deployment director Wang Ji Southern Court associate privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Xingzhong Prefecture administrator Xing Xinian was made Han mobile palace deployment director; Han mobile palace deployment director Wang Ji Southern Court associate privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳，獵馬尾山。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on yisi day hunted at Mawei Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Mawei Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，謁慶陵。

translations.literal: On dingsi day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，禁外官部內貸錢取息及使者館於民家。

translations.literal: On guihai day forbidden outer officials to lend money at interest within their jurisdictions and forbidden envoys to lodge in commoners' houses.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day outer officials were forbidden to lend money at interest within their jurisdictions and envoys were forbidden to lodge in commoners' houses.

sentences.zh: 八月，高麗王徽薨。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Goryeo king Hui died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Goryeo king Hui died.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on guimao new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao new moon of the ninth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己酉，射熊於白石山，加圍場使涅葛左金吾衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On jiyou day shot a bear at Baishi Mountain; hunting-grounds commissioner Niege promoted Left Defender of the Golden Crow Commandant grand general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day a bear was shot at Baishi Mountain; hunting-grounds commissioner Niege was promoted Left Defender of the Golden Crow Commandant grand general.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以高麗王徽子三韓國公勛權知國事。

translations.literal: On jisi day Goryeo king Hui's son Duke of Three Han Xun was ordered to administer state affairs provisionally.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Goryeo king Hui's son Duke of Three Han Xun was ordered to administer state affairs provisionally.

sentences.zh: 辛未，五國部長來貢。

translations.literal: On xinwei day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬申，召北、南樞密院官議政事。

translations.literal: On renshen day summoned Northern and Southern Privy Council officials to discuss government.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Northern and Southern Privy Council officials were summoned to discuss government.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁丑，謁觀德黔。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingchou day paid respects at Guande Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day of the tenth winter month the court paid respects at Guande Hall.

sentences.zh: 己卯，南院樞密使劉筠薨。

translations.literal: On jimao day Southern Court privy commissioner Liu Yun died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Southern Court privy commissioner Liu Yun died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，混同郡王耶律乙辛謀亡入宋，伏誅。

translations.literal: On renchen day Prince of Huntong Commandery Yelü Yixin plotted to flee into Song and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Prince of Huntong Commandery Yelü Yixin plotted to flee into Song and was executed.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午，進封梁王延禧為燕國王，大赦。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on bingwu day advanced Prince of Liang Yanxi to Prince of Yan and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day of the eleventh month Prince of Liang Yanxi was advanced to Prince of Yan and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 以南院宣徽使蕭何葛為南府宰相，三司使王經參知政事兼知樞密事。

translations.literal: Southern Court palace commissioner Xiao Hege was made Southern Court chancellor; Three Departments commissioner Wang Jing Associate Administrator of Affairs and administrator of privy affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Court palace commissioner Xiao Hege was made Southern Court chancellor; Three Departments commissioner Wang Jing Associate Administrator of Affairs and administrator of privy affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔僧善知讎校高麗所進佛經，頒行之。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, edict ordered monk Shanzhi to collate Buddhist scriptures presented by Goryeo and promulgate them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day an edict ordered monk Shanzhi to collate Buddhist scriptures presented by Goryeo and promulgate them.

sentences.zh: 己未，定諸令史、譯史遷敘等級。

translations.literal: On jiwei day fixed promotion grades for various clerks and translators.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day promotion grades were fixed for various clerks and translators.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，以邢熙年知南院樞密使事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on dinghai day Xing Xinian was made to administer Southern Court privy affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day of the twelfth month Xing Xinian was made to administer Southern Court privy affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以王言敷為漢人行宮都部署。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Wang Yanfu was made Han mobile palace deployment director.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Wang Yanfu was made Han mobile palace deployment director.

sentences.zh: 高麗三韓國公王勛薨。

translations.literal: Goryeo Duke of Three Han Wang Xun died.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo Duke of Three Han Wang Xun died.

sentences.zh: 是年，御前放進士李君裕等五十一人。

translations.literal: That year before the throne the jinshi Li Junyu and fifty-one others were passed.
translations.idiomatic: That year before the throne the jinshi Li Junyu and fifty-one others were passed.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月辛丑朔，如春水。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on xinchou new moon, went to spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, on the xinchou new moon of the first spring month the court went to spring waters.

sentences.zh: 丙午，復建南京奉福寺浮圖。

translations.literal: On bingwu day rebuilt the pagoda of Nanjing's Fengfu Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the pagoda of Nanjing's Fengfu Temple was rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，如山榆澱。

translations.literal: On wuchen day went to Shanyu Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the court went to Shanyu Marsh.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午朔，萌古國遣使來聘。

translations.literal: Second month, on gengwu new moon, Menggu State dispatched envoys with a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu new moon of the second month Menggu State sent envoys with a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申，遠萌古國遣使來聘。

translations.literal: Third month, on wushen day distant Menggu State dispatched envoys with a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day of the third month distant Menggu State sent envoys with a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命知制誥王師儒、牌印郎君耶律固傅導燕國王延禧。

translations.literal: On dingsi day ordered drafting edict commissioner Wang Shiru and seal-and-tally langjun Yelü Gu to tutor Prince of Yan Yanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day drafting edict commissioner Wang Shiru and seal-and-tally langjun Yelü Gu were ordered to tutor Prince of Yan Yanxi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑，女直貢良馬。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on dingchou day Jurchen presented fine horses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day of the fourth summer month Jurchen presented fine horses.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，駐蹕散水原。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on renxu day, halted at Sanshui Plain.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day of the fifth month the court halted at Sanshui Plain.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，阻卜來貢。

translations.literal: On yichou day Zubu came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Zubu came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，降國舅詳穩班位在敞穩之下。

translations.literal: On bingyin day demoted imperial maternal uncle detail-stable rank to below detail-stable.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day imperial maternal uncle detail-stable rank was demoted to below detail-stable.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，禁毀銅錢為器。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on renchen day forbidden destroying copper cash to make vessels.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day of the sixth month destroying copper cash to make vessels was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，如黑嶺。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiachen day, went to Heiling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day of the seventh autumn month the court went to Heiling.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，駐蹕藕絲澱。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on guihai day, halted at Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day of the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月乙未，改慶州大安軍曰興平。

translations.literal: Winter, twelfth month, on yiwei day changed Qing Prefecture's Da'an Army to Xingping.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day of the twelfth winter month Qing Prefecture's Da'an Army was changed to Xingping.

sentences.zh: 是月，改明年為大安，赦雜犯死罪以下。

translations.literal: That month the coming year was changed to Da'an and amnesty for mixed offenses from capital crime downward.
translations.idiomatic: That month the coming year was changed to Da'an and amnesty was granted for mixed offenses from capital crime downward.

sentences.zh: 大安元年春正月丁酉，如混同江。

translations.literal: In the first year of Da'an, spring, first month, on dingyou day, went to the Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Da'an, on dingyou day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，王績知南院樞密使事，邢熙年為中京留守。

translations.literal: On guimao day Wang Ji administrator of Southern Court privy affairs; Xing Xinian regent of the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Wang Ji was made administrator of Southern Court privy affairs; Xing Xinian regent of the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以樞密直學士杜公謂參知政事。

translations.literal: On wushen day Privy Council academician Du Gongyu Associate Administrator of Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Privy Council academician Du Gongyu was made Associate Administrator of Affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，五國酋長來貢良馬。

translations.literal: On gengxu day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute of fine horses.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute of fine horses.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未，如山榆澱。

translations.literal: Second month, on xinwei day went to Shanyu Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day of the second month the court went to Shanyu Marsh.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，宋主頊殂，子煦嗣位，使來告哀。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on yiyou day Song ruler Xiang died; his son Xu succeeded; envoys came to announce the mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day of the fourth summer month Song ruler Xiang died; his son Xu succeeded; envoys came to announce the mourning.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，西幸。

translations.literal: On xinmao day traveled west.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the court traveled west.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，駐蹕拖古烈。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on wuchen day, halted at Tuogulie.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day of the sixth month the court halted at Tuogulie.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以王績為南府宰相，蕭撻不也兼知南院樞密使事。

translations.literal: On renshen day Wang Ji was made Southern Court chancellor; Xiao Tabuye also administrator of Southern Court privy affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Wang Ji was made Southern Court chancellor; Xiao Tabuye also administrator of Southern Court privy affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，遣使吊祭於宋。

translations.literal: On dingchou day dispatched envoys to offer condolences in Song.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day envoys were dispatched to offer condolences in Song.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，宋遣王真、甄佑等饋其先帝遺物。

translations.literal: On wuyin day Song sent Wang Zhen, Zhen You, and others presenting the late emperor's bequeathed goods.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Song sent Wang Zhen, Zhen You, and others presenting the late emperor's bequeathed goods.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳，遣使賀宋主即位。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on yisi day dispatched envoys to congratulate the Song ruler on his accession.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day of the seventh autumn month envoys were dispatched to congratulate the Song ruler on his accession.

sentences.zh: 戊午，獵於赤山。

translations.literal: On wuwu day hunted at Red Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the court hunted at Red Mountain.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，幸慶州。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on dingmao day visited Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day of the eighth month the court visited Qing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，謁慶陵。

translations.literal: On wuchen day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，駐蹕好草澱。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on guihai day, halted at Haocao Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Haocao Marsh.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，夏國王李秉常遣使報其母梁氏哀。

translations.literal: On wuchen day Xia State king Li Bingchang dispatched envoys to announce his mother Lady Liang's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Xia State king Li Bingchang sent envoys to announce his mother Lady Liang's mourning.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以蕭撻不也為南院樞密使。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Xiao Tabuye was made Southern Court privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Xiao Tabuye was made Southern Court privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，詔「比者外官因譽進秩，久而不調，民被其害。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yiwei day, edict said: "Lately outer officials have advanced in rank through praise and long go without transfer, harming the people.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day of the eleventh month an edict said: "Lately outer officials have advanced in rank through praise and long go without transfer, harming the people.

sentences.zh: 今後皆以資給遷轉。

translations.literal: Henceforth all are to be transferred according to seniority of service.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth all are to be transferred according to seniority of service."

sentences.zh: 」丁酉，以南女直詳穩蕭袍裏為北府宰相。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Southern Jurchen detail-stable Xiao Paoli was made Northern Court chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Southern Jurchen detail-stable Xiao Paoli was made Northern Court chancellor.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，史臣進太祖以下七帝《實錄》。

translations.literal: On xinhai day historians presented the 《Veritable Records》 of the seven emperors from Taizu downward.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day historians presented the 《Veritable Records》 of the seven emperors from Taizu downward.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，遣使冊三韓國公王勛弟運為高麗國王。

translations.literal: On bingchen day dispatched envoys to invest Duke of Three Han Wang Xun's younger brother Yun as king of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day envoys were dispatched to invest Duke of Three Han Wang Xun's younger brother Yun as king of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔僧尼無故不得赴闕。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, edict ordered monks and nuns not to come to court without cause.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day an edict ordered monks and nuns not to come to court without cause.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，宋遣蔡卞來謝吊祭。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiaxu day Song dispatched Cai Bian to thank for the condolence mission.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the twelfth month Song sent Cai Bian to thank for the condolence mission.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛卯，如混同江。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on xinmao day, went to the Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on xinmao day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 己酉，五國諸部長來貢。

translations.literal: On jiyou day chieftains of various Five States tribes came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day chieftains of various Five States tribes came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，召權翰林學士趙孝嚴、知制誥王師儒等講《五經》大義。

translations.literal: On guichou day summoned acting Hanlin academician Zhao Xiaoyan, drafting edict commissioner Wang Shiru, and others to lecture on the great meaning of the 《Five Classics》.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day acting Hanlin academician Zhao Xiaoyan, drafting edict commissioner Wang Shiru, and others were summoned to lecture on the great meaning of the 《Five Classics》.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，駐蹕山榆澱。

translations.literal: Second month, on guiyou day, halted at Shanyu Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day of the second month the court halted at Shanyu Marsh.

sentences.zh: 是月，太白犯歲星。

translations.literal: That month Venus violated Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: That month Venus violated Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，女直貢良馬。

translations.literal: Third month, on yiyou day Jurchen presented fine horses.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day of the third month Jurchen presented fine horses.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，北幸。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on wuxu day, traveled north.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day of the fourth summer month the court traveled north.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，遣使加統軍使蕭訛都斡太子太保，裨將老古金吾衛大將軍，蕭雅哥靜江軍節度使，耶律燕奴右監門衛大將軍，仍賜賚諸軍士。

translations.literal: On guichou day dispatched envoys to promote supreme commander Xiao Eduwo to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, deputy general Laogu Defender of the Golden Crow Commandant grand general, Xiao Yage military commissioner of Jingjiang Army, Yelü Yannu Right Defender of the Gate Commandant grand general, and still bestow rewards on the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day envoys were dispatched to promote supreme commander Xiao Eduwo to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, deputy general Laogu Defender of the Golden Crow Commandant grand general, Xiao Yage military commissioner of Jingjiang Army, Yelü Yannu Right Defender of the Gate Commandant grand general, and still bestow rewards on the troops.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳朔，以牧馬蕃息多至百萬，賞群牧官，以次進階。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on dingsi new moon, because herds had multiplied to as many as a million, herd officials were rewarded and advanced in rank by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi new moon of the fifth month, because herds had multiplied to as many as a million, herd officials were rewarded and advanced in rank by degree.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，駐蹕納葛濼。

translations.literal: On yihai day halted at Nage Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the court halted at Nage Marsh.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，宰相梁穎出知興中府事。

translations.literal: On wuyin day Chancellor Liang Ying was dismissed as administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Chancellor Liang Ying was dismissed as administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是月，放進士張轂等二十六人。

translations.literal: That month the jinshi Zhang Gu and twenty-six others were passed.
translations.idiomatic: That month the jinshi Zhang Gu and twenty-six others were passed.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥朔，以左夷離畢耶律坦為惕隱，知樞密院事耶律斡特剌兼知左夷離畢事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on dinghai new moon, Left yilibi Yelü Tan tiyin; Yelü Wotela, who administered Privy Council affairs, also administrator of Left yilibi affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai new moon of the sixth month Left yilibi Yelü Tan was made tiyin; Yelü Wotela, who administered Privy Council affairs, also administrator of Left yilibi affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙申，阻卜來朝。

translations.literal: On bingshen day Zubu came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Zubu came to court.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，遣使按諸路獄。

translations.literal: On guimao day dispatched envoys to investigate prisons in all routes.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day envoys were dispatched to investigate prisons in all routes.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以同知南京留守事耶律那也知右夷離畢事。

translations.literal: On jiachen day associate regent of Nanjing Yelü Naye administrator of Right yilibi affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day associate regent of Nanjing Yelü Naye was made administrator of Right yilibi affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，阻卜酋長余古赧及愛的來朝，詔燕國王延禧相結為友。

translations.literal: On yisi day Zubu chiefs Yugunian and Aide came to court; edict ordered Prince of Yan Yanxi to bond with them as friends.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Zubu chiefs Yugunian and Aide came to court; an edict ordered Prince of Yan Yanxi to bond with them as friends.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以契丹行宮都部署耶律阿思兼知北院大王事。

translations.literal: On wushen day Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Asi also administrator of Northern Court great king affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Asi was also made administrator of Northern Court great king affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬子，高墩以下、縣令、錄事兄弟及子，悉許敘用。

translations.literal: On renzi day Gaodun and below, county magistrates, and record clerks' brothers and sons were all permitted to enter service by seniority.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Gaodun and below, county magistrates, and record clerks' brothers and sons were all permitted to enter service by seniority.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，惠妃母燕國夫人削古以厭魅梁王事覺，伏誅，子蘭陵郡王蕭酬斡除名，置邊郡，仍隸興聖宮。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on dingsi day Consort Hui's mother Lady Yan of Yan State Xiaogu, because sorcery against Prince of Liang was exposed, was executed; her son Prince of Lanling Commandery Xiao Chouwo was struck from the register and placed in a border commandery, still attached to Xing Sheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day of the seventh autumn month Consort Hui's mother Lady Yan of Yan State Xiaogu, because sorcery against Prince of Liang was exposed, was executed; her son Prince of Lanling Commandery Xiao Chouwo was struck from the register and placed in a border commandery, still attached to Xing Sheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊午，獵沙嶺。

translations.literal: On wuwu day hunted at Shaling.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the court hunted at Shaling.

sentences.zh: 甲子，賜興聖、積慶二宮貧民錢。

translations.literal: On jiazi day money was bestowed on poor people of Xing Sheng and Jiqing palaces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day money was bestowed on poor people of Xing Sheng and Jiqing palaces.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，出粟振遼州貧民。

translations.literal: On yiyou day grain was issued to relieve poor people in Liao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day grain was issued to relieve poor people in Liao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，以雪罷獵。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on wuzi day hunting was stopped because of snow.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day of the eighth month hunting was stopped because of snow.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，還上京。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on gengwu day returned to the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day of the ninth month the court returned to the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 壬申，發粟振上京、中京貧民。

translations.literal: On renshen day grain was issued to relieve poor people at the Supreme and Central capitals.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day grain was issued to relieve poor people at the Supreme and Central capitals.

sentences.zh: 丙子，謁二儀、五鸞二殿。

translations.literal: On bingzi day paid respects at the Two Principles and Five Phoenix halls.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the court paid respects at the Two Principles and Five Phoenix halls.

sentences.zh: 己卯，出太祖、太宗所禦鎧仗示燕國王延禧，諭以創業征伐之難。

translations.literal: On jimao day displayed armor and weapons used by Taizu and Taizong to Prince of Yan Yanxi, instructing him on the hardship of founding and campaigning.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day armor and weapons used by Taizu and Taizong were displayed to Prince of Yan Yanxi, instructing him on the hardship of founding and campaigning.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，召南府宰相議國政。

translations.literal: On xinsi day summoned the Southern Court chancellor to discuss state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Southern Court chancellor was summoned to discuss state affairs.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉朔，以樞密副使竇景庸知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on yiyou new moon, associate privy commissioner Dou Jingyong administrator of Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon of the tenth winter month associate privy commissioner Dou Jingyong was made administrator of Privy Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，五國部長來貢。

translations.literal: On bingxu day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以夏國王李秉常薨，遣使詔其子乾順知國事。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, because Xia State king Li Bingchang died, dispatched envoys to inform his son Qianshun to administer state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, because Xia State king Li Bingchang died, envoys were dispatched to inform his son Qianshun to administer state affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌，為燕國王延禧行再生禮，曲赦上京囚。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiaxu day performed the rebirth ritual for Prince of Yan Yanxi; partial amnesty for prisoners at the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the eleventh month the rebirth ritual was performed for Prince of Yan Yanxi; partial amnesty for prisoners at the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，高麗遣使謝封冊。

translations.literal: On wuyin day Goryeo dispatched envoys to thank for the investiture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Goryeo sent envoys to thank for the investiture.

sentences.zh: 癸未，出粟振乾、顯、成、懿四州貧民。

translations.literal: On guimao day grain was issued to relieve poor people in Qian, Xian, Cheng, and Yi prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day grain was issued to relieve poor people in Qian, Xian, Cheng, and Yi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛卯，以蘭陵郡王蕭撻不也為南院樞密使。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on xinmao day Prince of Lanling Commandery Xiao Tabuye was made Southern Court privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day of the twelfth month Prince of Lanling Commandery Xiao Tabuye was made Southern Court privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己亥，夏國王李乾順遣使上其父遺物。

translations.literal: On jihai day Xia State king Li Qianshun dispatched envoys presenting his father's bequeathed goods.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Xia State king Li Qianshun sent envoys presenting his father's bequeathed goods.
